title: asl_file
description: ASL data manipulation tool for FSL

ntis.description: Number of TIs in the file
ntis.title: Number of TIs

rpts.description: Number of repeats at each TI as comma separated list, not required if the number of repeats is same for all TIs  (only for use with --ibf=tis)
rpts.title: Repeats

pairs.description: Data contains adjacent pairs of measurements (e.g. Tag, Control) DEPRECATED use --iaf instead
pairs.title: Pairs

spairs.description: Split the pairs within the data, e.g. to separate tag and control images in output
spairs.title: Split pairs

diff.description: Take the difference between the pairs, i.e., Tag-control difference
diff.title: Difference

surrdiff.description: Do surround subtraction on the pairs
surrdiff.title: Surround subtraction

extrapolate.description: Option to extrapolate the edge of the brain to fix the artefact on the edge of the brain
extrapolate.title: Extrapolate

neighbour.description: Neighbour size for extrapolation, must be an odd number between 3 and 9. Default: 5
neighbour.title: Neighbour size

kernel.description: Kernel size (in voxels) of partial volume correction, must be an odd number between 3 and 9. Default: 5
kernel.title: Kernel size

mean.description: Output ASL data having taken mean at each TI to file
mean.title: Mean output

split.description: Split data into separate files for each TI, specify filename root
split.title: Split output

epoch.description: Output epochs of ASL data (takes mean at each TI within the epoch)
epoch.title: Epoch output

epoch_length.description: Length of epochs in number of repeats
epoch_length.title: Epoch length

epoch_overlap.description: Amount of overlap between epochs in number of repeats
epoch_overlap.title: Epoch overlap

deconv.description: Deconvolution of data with arterial input functions
deconv.title: Deconvolution

aif.description: Arterial input functions for deconvolution (4D volume, one aif for each voxel within mask)
aif.title: Arterial input functions
